title: Compare source snapshots
responsibility: Report sorted added, deleted and modified files by comparing snapshot values.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.before
inputs.description: Earlier snapshot keyed by source path and used as the baseline; a path it lacks is classified as added. Its values are compared with === against the same path in after, so only values that are === equal count as unchanged.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.after
inputs.description: Later snapshot keyed by source path and compared against before; a path it lacks is classified as deleted. Its values are compared with === against the same path in before, so only values that are === equal count as unchanged.

outputs.name: sourceChanges
outputs.description: One entry per path present in either snapshot, sorted by path with the default JavaScript string sort: 'added' when before lacks the path, 'deleted' when after lacks it, and 'modified' when both have it. Paths whose values are === equal are omitted, so a path whose stored value is undefined does not appear when the other snapshot lacks it.
